author: Scott Foster
text: Friendly and affordable!  Luke did an amazing job!  He took all steps necessary to ensure our tank was completely cleaned out.  When finished he made sure there was no trace that he was there.  We really appreciated his service!

author: Jeffrey Rodriguez
text: We would like to thank Luke for a job, well done! Our new septic tank has made a big difference. The pictures show the rock he had to deal with. The transition from old to new was within a weeks time. We recommend Mathews Septic Service. Great Job!!

author: Jason Bundy
text: Fair pricing, great communication, ON TIME, friendly, clean, concerned about lawn damage while pulling his trailer in & out of the yard. All around nice guy to hire for your septic needs!  Definitely would recommend..

author: Lindsey Tate
text:
Luke with Mathews Septic Service was an absolute pleasure to work with. His pricing was fair, and he took the time to clearly explain every step of the process. I came into this not really knowing what I needed—just that my system needed to be pumped and I wanted to avoid any future issues.

Luke walked me through how my tanks are set up, where the access points are, and what I can do moving forward to keep everything running smoothly. He also reassured me that calling when I did was the right decision, as there was enough solid buildup to potentially cause problems down the road.

I truly appreciate his professionalism, honesty, and thoroughness. I would confidently recommend Mathews Septic Service to anyone.

author: Christina Kay
text: Loved my service with Matthews Septic! Luke was very knowledgeable, friendly, and efficient. He even helped me with a possible issue with my septic drainage! Price is very reasonable! Will definitely call on him again for future service!
